ordinance: Building Zone Ordinance No. 5464 (New Series) of 1921 as amended to 1935
map_title: Use of Property Zone Map, City Planning Commission (M.M. O'Shaughnessy, City Engineer; R.S. Woodward, Asst. Engineer), Sections 1-14
structure: Use districts only. The 1921 ordinance sets no height, bulk, lot-coverage or setback districts; the only form-type provisions are inside the First Residential rules (two-family dwelling needs 5,000 sq ft open lot area; garages capped at 4 cars).
hierarchy: Cumulative: each district permits the uses of the more restrictive districts, except Heavy Industrial, which excludes dwellings.
boundary_rule: Sec. 15: boundaries are street lines unless shown otherwise. Where two designations appear in a block 200 ft or less wide, the less restricted district runs 100 ft back from its street line; in blocks wider than 200 ft, 137.5 ft back or the rear lot line of lots fronting the less restricted district.

zones.name: First Residential District
permitted_uses: Nurseries, farms, truck gardens and greenhouses
Usual accessories not involving a business, incl. office of a musician, physician or dentist in their own residence
Garage or group of garages for not more than four automobiles
Two-family dwelling, if at least 5,000 sq ft of open area remains on the lot
by_permit: Temporary building for commerce or industry incidental to construction or residential development (Board of Supervisors)
Stable for not more than two cows or two horses (Board of Supervisors)
form_rules: Two-family dwelling requires 5,000 sq ft of open area on the lot
Accessory garages limited to four automobiles
zones.summary: Single-family houses, schools, churches, clubhouses and garden uses. Two-family houses allowed only on lots leaving 5,000 sq ft open.

zones.name: Second Residential District
permitted_uses: Philanthropic and eleemosynary institution other than a correctional institution
zones.summary: Everything allowed in First Residential plus flats, apartments, tenements, boarding houses, hotels, hospitals and public buildings.

zones.name: Commercial District
permitted_uses: All residential uses (Sec. 3 and 4 uses may not be excluded)
Any business or commerce not listed as excluded
Light industries incidental to an amusement park
Light manufacturing above the ground floor, or incidental to a retail business on the premises
excluded_uses: Automobile repair shop, unless part of a public garage
Bakeries employing more than five persons
Carting, express or hauling yard, or storage yard other than for fuel
Laundry employing more than ten people
Uses excluded from the Light Industrial District
by_permit: Public garages and gasoline service stations (Board of Supervisors)
zones.summary: Retail, offices and general business plus all residential uses. Manufacturing barred except on upper floors or incidental to a shop on the premises.

zones.name: Light Industrial District
permitted_uses: Manufacturing and industry not listed as excluded
excluded_uses: Ammonia, chlorine or bleach powder manufacture
Brick, tile or terra cotta manufacture
Lime, cement or plaster of paris manufacture
Storage or baling of scrap, paper, rags or junk
Sulphuric, nitric or hydrochloric acid manufacture
Tar roofing or tar waterproofing manufacture
Uses that are a nuisance by emission of odor, dust, smoke, gas or noise
All uses excluded from Heavy Industrial Districts, except single dwellings, flats and tenement houses
by_permit: Iron, steel or brass foundries operating closed furnaces (Board of Supervisors)
zones.summary: Commercial uses plus most manufacturing. Bars 26 named heavy or noxious industries (refining, smelting, shipyards, gas and chemical works) and nuisance uses.

zones.name: Heavy Industrial District
permitted_uses: All industrial and commercial uses not listed as excluded
Dwelling quarters for an industrial watchman's family
excluded_uses: Single dwelling, flat or tenement house
Distillation of coal, bones or wood
Incineration or reduction of garbage, offal, dead animals or refuse
zones.summary: Heavy industry including refining, shipyards and smelting. Housing barred except a watchman's quarters; slaughtering, rendering and garbage reduction also barred.

zones.name: Unrestricted District
permitted_uses: Any use, subject only to other laws and ordinances
zones.summary: No use restrictions beyond other laws: the only district allowing abattoirs, rendering, fertilizer and garbage reduction.

form_fields.min_lot_sqft: Minimum lot area for new lots (sq ft)
form_fields.lot_sqft_per_unit: Lot area required per dwelling unit (sq ft); in C districts it follows the nearest R district
form_fields.max_units_per_lot: Dwelling units allowed per lot (0 = no housing)
form_fields.height_limit_ft: Height limit for dwellings (ft); null where FAR governs
